jsonld.name: Alpha Custom Carpentry
jsonld.description: Alpha Custom Carpentry, a custom carpentry and trim business based in Fort Myers, FL specialized in kitchen and bathroom cabinetry, custom shelving, wainscoting and post-storm reconstruction carpentry.

eyebrow.es: Fort Myers, FL · Carpintería a medida

parrafo.es: Alpha Custom Carpentry construye y repara molduras, wainscoting, closets y gabinetes a medida en Fort Myers, FL. Luis y su equipo se encargan desde remodelaciones de cocina hasta reconstrucción después de huracanes, con el mismo cuidado en cada trabajo.
parrafo.en: Alpha Custom Carpentry builds and repairs custom trim, wainscoting, closets and cabinetry across Fort Myers, FL. Luis and his crew handle everything from kitchen remodels to post-hurricane reconstruction, with the same hands-on care in every job.

hero.imagen_alt: Custom kitchen island and cabinetry built by Alpha Custom Carpentry in Fort Myers, FL

parrafo_1.es: Alpha Custom Carpentry es un negocio de Fort Myers, FL dirigido por Luis, que construye molduras, wainscoting, repisas y gabinetes a medida para casas en todo el suroeste de Florida. Los clientes contratan a Luis directamente para remodelaciones de cocina y baño, closets a medida y reconstrucción después de tormentas.
parrafo_1.en: Alpha Custom Carpentry is a Fort Myers, FL business led by Luis, building custom trim, wainscoting, shelving and cabinetry for homes across Southwest Florida. Clients hire Luis directly for kitchen and bathroom remodels, custom built-ins and post-storm reconstruction work.

parrafo_2.es: 34 reseñas en Google respaldan una calificación de 4.9: trabajo de moldura limpio, plazos honestos y un equipo que trata cada casa como propia.
parrafo_2.en: 34 reviews on Google back a 4.9 rating: clean trim work, honest timelines and a crew that treats every home like their own.

texto.es: Llama o envía fotos de tu espacio y lo que tienes en mente; Luis te da una primera idea antes de agendar una visita.
texto.en: Call or text with photos of your space and what you have in mind; Luis will give you a first read before scheduling a visit.

texto.es: Luis llega a medir, habla de materiales y te da un alcance y precio claro antes de empezar cualquier trabajo.
texto.en: Luis comes out to measure, talk through materials and give you a clear scope and price before any work starts.

texto.es: La moldura, los gabinetes o los closets se miden, cortan e instalan en sitio con el mismo cuidado que ves en las fotos.
texto.en: Custom trim, cabinetry or built-ins are measured, cut and installed on site with the same attention to detail you see in the photos.

texto.es: Recorren juntos el espacio terminado, el área queda limpia y te quedas con el número de Luis para el próximo proyecto.
texto.en: You walk the finished space together, the area is left clean, and you keep Luis's number for the next project.

nota.es: Cada proyecto se cotiza después de que Luis ve el espacio en persona. Llama para agendar una visita y recibir un precio claro antes de empezar.
nota.en: Every project is quoted after Luis sees the space in person. Call to set up a visit and get a clear price before work starts.

texto.es: Molduras de corona, wainscoting, rodapiés y molduras decorativas instaladas y acabadas a juego con tu casa.
texto.en: Crown molding, wainscoting, baseboards and decorative trim installed and finished to match your home.

texto.es: Gabinetes, tocadores y carpintería de acabado para remodelaciones completas de cocina y baño, de principio a fin.
texto.en: Cabinetry, vanities and finish carpentry for full kitchen and bathroom remodels, start to finish.

texto.es: Repisas flotantes, closets y espacios de almacenamiento diseñados y construidos a la medida exacta de tu espacio.
texto.en: Floating shelves, closets and built-in storage designed and built to fit your space exactly.

texto.es: Carpintería para reparaciones y reconstrucción después de tormentas, incluyendo trabajo realizado tras el huracán Ian.
texto.en: Carpentry for post-storm repairs and reconstruction, including work completed after Hurricane Ian.

pie.es: ¿No ves exactamente lo que necesitas? Llama y te confirmamos si podemos ayudarte.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what you need? Call and we will confirm whether we can help.

items.quote: Luis put up wainscoting in my bathroom with nice trim top and painted the bathroom. He also installed the wood shelves. He did a fantastic job! Happy with the work he did.
My experience with Alpha Custom Carpentry couldn't be better. Luis's workmanship was top notch. I had my kitchen and two bathrooms updated and the work was completed in two weeks.

We highly recommend Luis (Alpha Custom Carpentry). The days following Hurricane Ian a friend had recommended Luis to us for our reconstruction needs of our first floor condo. We met with Luis and immediately had a good vibe with him.
